The prompt says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". So likely reaction_id is the template identifier. We'll use 208284.

We need to return dict with mapped_rxn string and template_id integer.

'[CH3:1][N:2]1[CH2:3][CH2:5][CH2:6][CH:7]1[C:8]1=[CH:9][N:10]=[CH:11][CH:12]=[CH:13]1.[Br-].[Na+].Br.O=Br(=O)[O-].[Na+].BrBr.Cl.[Zn].CC(=[O:4])O>>[CH3:1][N:2]1[C:3](=[O:4])[CH2:5][CH2:6][C@H:7]1[C:8]1=[CH:9][N:10]=[CH:11][CH:12]=[CH:13]1'

We should verify that this reaction corresponds to amide formation from carboxylic acid and amine. It seems to involve a cyclized amine? Might be generic.

But we need to ensure that this template applies to our target molecule. Could test with check_smiles_reaction_template_matching. Let's do that.
